payload.core_composition_summary: The solution uses brute force over all 6 periodic patterns and answers range queries via prefix sums; it is a single algorithmic approach without multi-mechanism composition.
payload.rationale: The algorithm enumerates all permutations of 'abc' (complete search) and computes mismatch counts using prefix sums for O(1) queries. The prefix sums are precomputation, not a separate DP mechanism. Thus, it is not a true composition of distinct paradigms.
